 Liberia vs Cape Verde Preview & Prediction | 2027 Africa Cup of Nations Qualifying
 by Alex Lawes · 16 November 2026 at 1:14 pm 
 Post 
 Share 
 Click here for today’s sports betting tips from our expert analysts! 
 Liberia come up against the summer’s surprise package Cape Verde at the Samuel Kanyon Doe Sports Complex in Monrovia on Tuesday. 
 Kick-off date/time: 
 17 November 2026 at 7:00 pm 
 How to watch on TV & online:  UK – Not televised / USA – beIN Sports & associated streaming platforms
 Liberia vs Cape Verde prediction 
 Liberia have started their 2027 CAF Africa Cup of Nations qualification campaign with three defeats from three against Rwanda, Mali and Cape Verde with the Cape Verdeans having lost two from two last month.
 That was until they defeated Liberia by four goals to two in the reverse fixture at Estadio Nacional de Cabo Verde in Praia the other day with strikes from Ayoni Santos, Jose Luis Rocha Tavares, Dailon Livramento and Derensili Sanches Fernandes.
 Having reached the knockout stages of FIFA World Cup 2026 and taken Argentina to extra-time, Cape Verde had a bit of a hangover last month but should now round off a famous year with back-to-back victories.
 Liberia vs Cape Verde tip:  Cape Verde to win
